note: Articles publish in order, one per weekly run (Tue 16:00 UTC). The publisher takes queue[0], wires it in, then removes it. Refill this list to keep weeks of hands-off publishing ready. Each article HTML lives in _queue/ and uses {{DATE}} and {{MONTH_YEAR}} placeholders filled with the real publish date.

queue.title: The Shelf Talker Nobody Reads
queue.description: Most of what a brand writes for the store goes unread. A look at what actually communicates a product to a shopper who gives it about two seconds.

queue.title: The Rejection Email Deserves Care
queue.description: Most companies treat the rejection message as cleanup. It is the last thing a candidate hears from you, and it says more about your hiring than the job posting does.

queue.title: The Quiet Cost of Slow Decisions
queue.description: Indecision rarely looks like failure while it is happening. It looks like diligence, and its costs show up later in people who stop bringing you their best ideas.

queue.title: The Meeting That Should Have Been Nothing
queue.description: Most recurring meetings survive because nobody remembers deciding to keep them. A look at how I audit my own calendar and what I have learned from cancelling things.
